differences.what: A module, exam_pulmonary, that the General note type includes: its section Pulmonary / respiratory shows only while Pulmonary (exam.systems is pulmonary) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: Work of breathing is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.

Right Lung and Left Lung are one field, Auscultation, recorded for each side, choose-many from the shared list lung_findings (the seven words both lists write). Clear is its normal option and clears the others.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory section 5 (lung findings), default 13, 26; forms 4.3 (sides)

differences.what: Location is asked for each lung: two fields, Location, right lung and Location, left lung, each choose-many and shown only while that lung has a finding other than Clear.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 21; forms 2.3 (a follow-up for one side is two fields)

differences.what: Other findings is choose-many with no normal option: Normal leaves it empty.
Respiratory symptoms is choose-many with no normal option: Normal leaves it empty.
Sputum Details is two short text fields, Sputum color and Sputum amount, shown only while Sputum is picked. The bullets Color and Amount are their labels, not options.
